crossRefs.note: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, and saying,
Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

translations.web: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
translations.bsb: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, Jesus was met by a large crowd.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, on the next day, when they were come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
